en.hubeali:
Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali Bin Uqba, from Ayoub Bin Al Hurr, from Abdul A’ala, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The arrogance is that you belittle the people and consider the Truth as foolish’.
en.sarwar: 8. Abu Ali al-Ash’ari has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from ibn Faddal from Ali ibn ‘Uqbah from Ayyub ibn al-Hurr from ‘Abd al-‘Ala’ from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Arrogance is when one belittles the people and calls the truth foolishness.”
